text:
Marta (Partnerships): Quick FYI  QuantaPay listing is live on CloudMart and they signed a 12-month Dedicated + marketplace package this morning. URL: https://cloudmart.market/quantapay. This is the low-latency fraud scoring pilot conversion we tracked. :tada:
Eli (AE): PO received and entered. Deal includes Dedicated throughput commitment (monthly GPU pools) + priority support. Upsell: real-time scoring SLA add-on. Sending invoice to finance.
Rashid (Customer Success): Onboarding kickoff complete. Verified VPC peering, API key rotation, and test vectors for fraud model. Note: realtime webhook retries default to 5s backoff; they want 1s for critical paths  logged a follow-up with @Gwen.
Gwen (Solutions): PR for webhook backoff param merged. Config snippet for routing low-latency scoring to Dedicated pool:
```
ROUTING.policy = "low_latency"
ROUTING.dedicated_pool = "quantapay-dedicated"
WEBHOOK.retry_interval = 1s
```
Tested with QuantaPay sandbox and validated p95 latency <40ms.
marketplace-bot: Listing status: draft -> published. Link: https://cloudmart.market/quantapay (published 09:07 UTC).
Liam (Marketing): Amazing! Can we get a quick customer quote for the case study and a screenshot of the scoring dashboard? Webinar + blog next week.
Marta (Partnerships): @Eli please request a 1-2 sentence quote from their Head of Risk. @Rashid can you grab the screenshot from the staging demo and drop into GH doc?
Eli (AE): Quote requested. Also noting negotiated terms: 6% onboarding credit in month 1 and a 20% commit discount for annual payment (logged in CRM).
Amaya (Legal): Confirmed marketplace addendum and DPA signed. No extra IP clauses. Noted audit retention at customer-specified 180 days.
Rashid (Customer Success): Uploaded onboarding runbook: https://redwood-internal/playbooks/quantapay-onboard.md. Screenshot and replay clip uploaded to the GH doc. Also set demo token TTL=1h for their sandbox.
Eli (AE): Received quote: "Redwood's dedicated inference reduced fraud decisioning latency so we could block attacks in near-real time." Sending to @Liam.
Liam (Marketing): Perfect  I'll draft the case study + webinar landing page and a CloudMart spotlight card. Will share first draft tomorrow.
Gwen (Solutions): Small doc note for ops: when routing to Dedicated pool, enable `kv_cache=false` for micro-batches to reduce cold-start tail latency. PR posted to docs repo.
marketplace-bot: Analytics event: first 12h impressions=4.8k, installs=72, trials=11.
Marta (Partnerships): Scheduling co-marketing sync with QuantaPay for next Tue. Adding Asana: "QuantaPay case study + CloudMart spotlight" assigned to @Liam, @Rashid, @Gwen. Closing thread  great cross-functional effort! :rocket:
